SELECT f.file_id, f.file_name, f.file_size, f.mime_type, f.created_at, f.uploaded_by, f.tenant_id, m.electronic_approval_id, m.title AS document_title, c.comment_id FROM public.tb_common_file f LEFT JOIN public.tb_common_comment c ON f.owner_type = 'APPROVAL_COMMENT' AND c.comment_id = f.owner_id AND c.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND c.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND c.comment_type = 'USER' AND c.deleted_yn = 'N' JOIN public.tb_electronic_approval_main m ON m.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND ((f.owner_type = 'APPROVAL' AND m.electronic_approval_id = f.owner_id) OR (f.owner_type = 'APPROVAL_COMMENT' AND m.electronic_approval_id = c.owner_id))
AND f.deleted_yn = 'N' AND f.file_usage_type = 'ATTACHMENT'
mapper.select: WITH related_files AS () SELECT file_id FROM related_files WHERE file_id = #{beforeFileId}

WITH related_files AS () SELECT f.file_id, f.file_name, f.file_size, f.mime_type, f.created_at, f.electronic_approval_id, f.document_title, f.comment_id, COALESCE(( SELECT u.user_nm FROM public.tb_login_account la JOIN public.tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id AND u.login_id = la.login_id WHERE la.tenant_id = f.tenant_id AND la.login_code = f.uploaded_by ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT 1 ), '알 수 없음') AS uploaded_by_name FROM related_files f
WHERE (f.created_at, f.file_id) < ( SELECT cursor_file.created_at, cursor_file.file_id FROM related_files cursor_file WHERE cursor_file.file_id = #{beforeFileId} )
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.file_id DESC LIMIT 21

SELECT CAST(u.user_id AS varchar) AS user_id, u.user_nm AS user_name, d.department_nm AS department_name FROM public.tb_user u JOIN public.tb_login_account la ON la.login_id = u.login_id AND la.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND la.use_at = 'Y' LEFT JOIN public.tb_department d ON d.department_id = u.department_id AND d.tenant_id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.use_at = 'Y' AND CAST(u.user_id AS varchar) IN
#{participantUserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info SET action_status = 'WAITING', pending_at = NULL, action_at = NULL, action_comment = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT')
mapper.select: SELECT electronic_approval_line_id, stage_order, participant_order, participant_type, participant_user_id, participant_name, participant_department_name, action_status, pending_at, action_at, action_comment FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} AND stage_order > 1 AND participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') AND action_status = 'APPROVED' AND action_at IS NOT NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info SET action_status = 'WAITING', pending_at = NULL, action_at = NULL, action_comment = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND stage_order > #{stageOrder} AND participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') AND action_status = 'PENDING' AND action_at IS NULL AND action_comment IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND stage_order > 1 AND participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') AND action_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'RETURNED')
mapper.update: UPDATE public.tb_electronic_approval_main SET drafting_work_category_id = #{draftingWorkCategoryId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, document_type = #{documentType}, eabus_no = #{eabusNo}, title = #{title}, contents_json = CAST(#{contentsJson} AS jsonb), contents_html = #{contentsHtml}, contents_text = #{contentsText}, drafter_name = #{drafterName}, drafter_department_name = #{drafterDepartmentName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{drafterId} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND drafter_id = #{drafterId} AND document_status IN ('DRAFT', 'REVISION_REQUESTED') AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info ( tenant_id, electronic_approval_id, stage_order, participant_order, participant_type, participant_user_id, participant_name, participant_department_name, action_status, pending_at, action_at, action_comment, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{electronicApprovalId}, #{stageOrder}, #{participantOrder}, #{participantType}, #{participantUserId}, #{participantName}, #{participantDepartmentName}, #{actionStatus}, #{pendingAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{actionAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{actionComment}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select:
SELECT m.electronic_approval_id, m.document_no, m.eabus_no, m.document_type, m.document_status, m.title, m.drafter_name, m.drafter_department_name, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.submitted_at, NULL::varchar AS notice_type, COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg(line.participant_name, ', ' ORDER BY line.stage_order, line.participant_order) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info line WHERE line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id ), '') AS participant_name, CASE WHEN m.drafter_id = #{drafterId} THEN 'DRAFTER' ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT my_line.participant_type, ', ' ORDER BY my_line.participant_type) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info my_line WHERE my_line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND my_line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND my_line.participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} ), '') END AS my_participant_type, COALESCE(( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT my_line.action_status, ', ' ORDER BY my_line.action_status) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info my_line WHERE my_line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND my_line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND my_line.participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} AND my_line.action_status IS NOT NULL ), '') AS my_action_status, COALESCE(( SELECT line.stage_order::varchar || '단계 · ' || string_agg(line.participant_name, ', ' ORDER BY line.participant_order) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info line WHERE line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND line.participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') AND line.action_status = 'PENDING' AND line.stage_order = ( SELECT MIN(active_line.stage_order) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info active_line WHERE active_line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND active_line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND active_line.participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') AND active_line.action_status = 'PENDING' ) GROUP BY line.stage_order ), '') AS current_approval_step, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE line.action_status = 'APPROVED')::varchar || '/' || COUNT(*)::varchar FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info line WHERE line.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND line.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND line.participant_type IN ('APPROVAL', 'AGREEMENT') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ), '') AS approval_progress FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m
ORDER BY
m.electronic_approval_id substring(m.document_no from 4 for 8) || lpad(split_part(m.document_no, '-', 3), 19, '0') m.eabus_no m.title m.document_type m.document_status m.submitted_at m.drafter_name m.drafter_department_name my_participant_type my_action_status current_approval_step participant_name approval_progress m.updated_at
ASC DESC , m.electronic_approval_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m

SELECT m.electronic_approval_id, m.document_no, m.eabus_no, m.document_type, m.document_status, m.title, m.drafter_name, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.submitted_at, LEFT(COALESCE(m.contents_text, ''), 240) AS summary, NULL::varchar AS notice_type, (m.drafter_id = #{drafterId}) AS is_drafter FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m
ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m

SELECT m.electronic_approval_id, m.document_no, m.eabus_no, m.document_type, m.document_status, m.title, m.drafter_name, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.submitted_at, LEFT(COALESCE(m.contents_text, ''), 240) AS summary, NULL::varchar AS notice_type FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m JOIN public.tb_electronic_approval_pin p ON p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info l WHERE l.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND l.participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} AND l.action_status = 'PENDING' ) THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS action_required_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.document_status IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS in_progress_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.drafter_id = #{drafterId} AND m.document_status = 'DRAFT' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS draft_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.document_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS completed_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.document_status = 'REVISION_REQUESTED' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS revision_requested_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.document_status = 'REJECTED' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) AS rejected_count FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted_yn = 'N'

SELECT m.electronic_approval_id, m.document_no, m.eabus_no, m.document_type, m.document_status, m.title, m.drafter_name, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.submitted_at, LEFT(COALESCE(m.contents_text, ''), 240) AS summary, CASE WHEN m.document_status = 'REVISION_REQUESTED' THEN 'REVISION_REQUESTED' ELSE 'ACTION_REQUIRED' END AS notice_type FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted_yn = 'N'
AND ( ( m.drafter_id = #{drafterId} AND m.document_status = 'REVISION_REQUESTED' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info l WHERE l.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND l.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id AND l.participant_user_id = #{participantUserId} AND l.action_status = 'PENDING' ) ) ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT m.electronic_approval_id, m.drafting_work_category_id, m.document_no, m.eabus_no, m.document_type, m.document_status, m.drafter_name, la.profile_image AS drafter_profile_image, m.created_at, m.submitted_at, m.title, m.contents_json::text AS contents_json, m.contents_html, m.contents_text, m.view_count, (m.drafter_id = #{drafterId}) AS is_drafter FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_main m LEFT JOIN public.tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND la.login_code = m.drafter_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} AND m.deleted_yn = 'N'

INSERT INTO public.tb_electronic_approval_view_history ( tenant_id, electronic_approval_id, login_id, viewed_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{electronicApprovalId}, #{loginId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, electronic_approval_id, login_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING view_history_id

SELECT line.electronic_approval_line_id, line.stage_order, line.participant_order, line.participant_type, line.participant_user_id, line.participant_name, line.participant_department_name, la.profile_image AS participant_profile_image, CASE WHEN line.participant_type = 'APPROVAL' AND line.action_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'RETURNED') THEN la.stamp_image ELSE NULL END AS participant_stamp_image, line.action_status, line.pending_at, line.action_at, line.action_comment FROM public.tb_electronic_approval_line_info line LEFT JOIN public.tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = line.tenant_id AND CAST(u.user_id AS varchar) = line.participant_user_id LEFT JOIN public.tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND la.login_id = u.login_id WHERE line.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND line.electronic_approval_id = #{electronicApprovalId} ORDER BY line.stage_order, line.participant_order
